children: Horizon Technology Finance updated its securitization platform through three coordinated agreements. The company extended the Legal Final Payment Date of its securitization to December 10, 2035 via a Second Supplemental Indenture with the trustee. Concurrently, it executed a Second Amended and Restated Note Funding Agreement with initial purchasers and entered Amendment No. 2 to the Sale and Servicing Agreement to align operations with the new terms. The actions are intended to enhance funding stability, maintain capital access, and streamline servicing under the program.
